steps.title: Define project metadata and structure
steps.description: Establish the application configuration values for Date Time Only including the package ID com.datetimeonly.app.

steps.title: Configure standard build environment
steps.description: Configure build.gradle compatibility with Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2, Java 17, and standard SDK level 34.

steps.title: Configure application manifest and launcher activity
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml containing launch filters, orientation config-changes to support landscape orientation beautifully, and setup proper Material styles.

steps.title: Design application layout interface
steps.description: Set up a clean modern RelativeLayout in activity_main.xml with standard typography, monospace digital clock styling, and modern customization controls layout.

steps.title: Set up MainActivity.java core imports
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java file declaring package 'com.datetimeonly.app' and importing pure standard Android SDK views, handlers, and formats.

steps.title: Implement clock ticking task schedule
steps.description: Introduce an efficient Handler and Runnable ticking loop to refresh the datetime values on the display 5 times per second for high accuracy.

steps.title: Add time and date parsing formatter
steps.description: Setup flexible formats for 12-hour (with AM/PM indicators) and 24-hour presentation options using SimpleDateFormat.

steps.title: Create color style profiles
steps.description: Define beautiful color presets (Retro green LED, Cyberpunk cyan, Warm amber, Classic white, Crimson red) for night bedside usage.

steps.title: Bind settings and configuration button controls
steps.description: Program click handlers using classic Java 8 compatible anonymous classes to toggle formats, seconds visibility, and cycle themes.

steps.title: Incorporate dynamic controls visibility trigger
steps.description: Enable interactive tap listener on background layout to show and hide the settings bar dynamically to present clean 'date and time only'.

steps.title: Build system UI immersive fullscreen features
steps.description: Implement interactive flags handling to enter custom sticky landscape/portrait immersive layout mode without system bars showing.

steps.title: Manage runtime activity state callbacks
steps.description: Add cycle safe-keepers onPause and onResume to start/stop the Handler thread to prevent battery drain when screen is off.

steps.title: Verify namespace validation and compatibility configuration
steps.description: Double check all xmlns schemas inside AndroidManifest.xml and verify sourceCompatibility levels are set exactly to Java 1.8.

steps.title: Perform layout structural analysis
steps.description: Test alignment, keepScreenOn features, layout margins, and button sizes to deliver an incredibly polished client application.

steps.title: Building Date Time Only
steps.description: Assemble and build debug APK package for deployment on target phone simulation environments.
